cards.lore: It has been running the civilization while you were busy thinking about other things. You are the other things.
cards.power: THE HOST. Play at start. The table defines the "Health" of the City. If the City falls, the game ends.

cards.lore: You have never once told this city what to do. It has never once asked your permission.
cards.power: THE PERMEABLE SELF. You are a superorganism. +1 to all Rolls involving "Gut Instinct."

cards.lore: A machine is a human-designed system. The body is older than the concept of machines.
cards.power: BLÖDSINN! Once per session, negate a rule lawyer by shouting "BIOLOGY IS MESSY!"

cards.lore: Es war einmal das Leben. Once upon a time, there was life. Good luck.
cards.power: START SEQUENCE. Roll a d6. 1-3: Inflammation. 4-8: Homeostasis.

cards.lore: The brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.
cards.power: RHYTHM. The Quest Die cannot move more than 2 steps in any single round. Stability is enforced.

cards.lore: The decision was already underway 500ms before you 'made' it. You are the press secretary, not the president.
cards.power: INTERPRETATION. Reframe any Stage card's meaning rather than its fact. The story changes, reality doesn't.

cards.lore: 70 square meters folded into your chest. The only autonomic function with a manual override.
cards.power: RHYTHM RESET. Any Actor may narrate a deliberate breath to return their die 1 step toward center.

cards.lore: 180 liters filtered daily to produce 1.5 liters of consequences. The original doping agency.
cards.power: PRECISION MAINTENANCE. The Quest Die cannot drift more than 1 step without explicit cause.

cards.lore: Prometheus was anatomically correct. It's the only organ that grows back.
cards.power: PROCESSING. Resolve toxin cards one round faster. Once per session: Regenerate a used card at 50% power.

cards.lore: 80% of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.
cards.power: SOMATIC SIGNAL. Add a physical, non-verbal response to any Brain narration. It cannot be overridden by logic.

cards.lore: A library of every murder attempt since 1987. It remembers things you have forgotten.
cards.power: MEMORY. Instantly resolve a threat encountered previously in the session. The library remembers.

cards.lore: The same molecule creates trust and tribalism. It's not a bug, it's a feature.
cards.power: THE SLOW WAVE. Effects persist for two rounds. You cannot recall the broadcast.

cards.lore: It is a physical motor. It actually spins. You are not storing energy; you are cycling it.
cards.power: POWER GRID. +1 die movement for everyone. Failure to act = -2 movement (blackout).

cards.lore: You moved your hand before you felt the pain. The nervous system got there first.
cards.power: SIGNAL PRIORITY. Resolves instantly before any other card. No memory; it happens, then it's gone.

cards.lore: One error per billion letters. You have had cancer many times; the spider usually eats it.
cards.power: COPY. Duplicate a Stage card. Roll d6: on a 1, the copy is Mutated (slightly altered effect).

cards.lore: The shape is the answer. When the shape fails, the memory fails.
cards.power: FORM IS FUNCTION. +2 movement for narrations with internal consistency. Contradictions are BLÖDSINN!'d.

cards.lore: The response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.
cards.power: CHRONIC DRAIN. -1 die movement for all. Cannot be removed until the "source" is found.

cards.lore: Evolution occurring inside you. It is not a disease; It is a competitor.
cards.power: COMPOUNDING GROWTH. Gains +1 effect every round it is ignored. Requires specific narration to resolve.

cards.lore: The discrimination fails, not the weapon. The gun works fine; it's just pointed the wrong way.
cards.power: MISDIRECTED STRENGTH. The strongest Actor becomes the target. Success hurts the self.

cards.lore: Your immune repertoire was built when you were a teenager. Hope you read good books.
cards.power: SENESCENCE. No new strategies (cards) can be drawn this round. Play with what you have.

cards.lore: He looked at the body instead of the book. He was 28. Everyone else was wrong.
cards.power: EMPIRICISM. Ignore a Rule Card by pointing to a visible fact on the table.

cards.lore: The math proved the liver couldn't make that much blood. It was a math problem first.
cards.power: CIRCULATION. Return a card from the Discard pile to your hand. It comes back around.

cards.lore: He saved the mothers. The doctors committed him to an asylum. He died of the infection he identified.
cards.power: PREVENTATIVE MEASURE. Negate a future threat before it appears. Everyone mocks you for it.

cards.lore: The evidence is available. The implication is uncomfortable. We reject the finding.
cards.power: DELAYED VINDICATION. A correct move is rejected for 2 rounds. In Round 3, it resolves with triple impact.

cards.lore: The hardest structural material is also the busiest factory. 2 million cells per second.
cards.power: HIDDEN PRODUCTION. Generate a resource token from a structure meant for defense.

cards.lore: You have a hole in your vision. The brain fills it in with best guesses. Trust, but verify.
cards.power: PREDICTIVE MODEL. Describe what should be there. Treat it as if it is there.

cards.lore: The pattern persists. The atoms cycle. You are a standing wave.
cards.power: MATERIAL CYCLE. Swap your character's Trait for a new one. You are not the person you were 7 years ago.

cards.lore: Sleep is not rest. It is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.
cards.power: MAINTENANCE WINDOW. Skip a turn to remove all negative status effects.

cards.lore: Every history event happened inside a body. Caesar was stabbed in a specific anatomy.
cards.power: INNER SPACE. All 'Location' cards are now considered 'Internal Organs'.

cards.lore: Wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.
cards.power: BALANCE. Force a trade of resources to equalize two players.

cards.lore: The emergency system running 24/7. The comfort zone is a chemical state.
cards.power: KEEPING SMALL. Trigger a 'Daily Grind' effect to suppress a heroic action.

cards.lore: The body keeps the score because the body IS the score.
cards.power: TRAUMATIC ENCODING. A failed roll becomes a permanent scar (new flaw).
